map.AWG 数字越大越细？: Does a larger AWG number mean a thinner wire?
map.是。 AWG 数字越大截面积越小、电阻越大、载流量越低；AWG 24 常用于网线: Yes. The larger the AWG number the smaller the cross-section, the higher the resistance and the lower the ampacity; AWG 24 is commonly used for network cables and control signals.
